subject: prd/impl-review
statement: Before production activation, the reviewer shall complete its ten-review calibration checkpoint and the parent routing contract's full pre-release seam gate; when both are green, the release shall activate the validated review-demand process for every supported production proposal in one switch, with no shadow, canary, advisory production cohort, or zero-review path, and every production proposal shall require a satisfying complete pass set before acceptance.
rationale: calibration remains a pre-release proof obligation, while production runs one authoritative review contract
fit_criterion: pre-release fixtures and dogfood may not authorize production acceptance; one production configuration covers the complete support matrix; request-changes, absent, stale, invalid, and incomplete pass sets block acceptance; inspection finds no cohort or advisory production bypass
